heading: If you or your family use these clinics
intro: Quality varies enormously between facilities. Knowing that most clinics fall short, especially on newborn care, cervical screening and emergency supplies, helps you ask the right questions and push for a higher-level facility when it matters.

heading: If you work in a facility
intro: The strongest predictors of quality here are things a facility can act on: trained staff, enough nurses, stocked emergency supplies, and functional management and quality-improvement teams.

heading: If you shape health policy
intro: Only 1 in 10 facilities met the standard, and the gaps cluster at dispensary level and in private facilities. Targeting supplies, newborn infrastructure, cervical screening and team functionality would do the most to raise quality.
